For the Camera item in {{MM|-}} and {{TWW|-}}, see [[Picto Box]].}} {{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Sprite TFH= File:TFH Camera Icon.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Camera Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Camera Icon.png }} |caption= |type= |game= TFH, BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= {{Infobox Game Blocks |TFH= [[Miiverse Gallery]] |BotW= [[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]] }} |uses= {{List| * Taking Pictures * Logging entries into the Hyrule Compendium }} |strength= |durability= |comp= [[Picto Box]] |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Camera|Cameras|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|TFH, BotW, TotK, AoC}}{{Cite|'''{{Big|Camera}}
Instantly render a visible image into a picture.'''
{{Small|Pictures created are saved in the album. It has a useful feature that connects to the Hyrule Compendium and automatically registers pictures of new entries.}}|Runes|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Camera}}
Capture images using the Purah Pad. You can then save them to the album.|Inventory|TotK}}{{Name Ref|TFH, AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{TFH|-}}=== In {{TFH}}, the Camera is given to [[Link]] by the [[Photo Bro]] at the [[Miiverse Gallery]].{{Cite|Hm? You don't have a camera?! Dude, my camera has a camera! No worries, bro. You can use mine.|Photo Bro|TFH}} The Camera is used to take screenshots of [[Level]]s of the [[Drablands]] by pressing the 'X' button; after the Level's completion, the most recent screenshot to be taken is saved to the Miiverse Gallery's photo album. Up to 99 photos can be saved to the photo album; the photos can be posted onto [[Miiverse]] from the Miiverse Gallery,{{Note|The Miiverse service was discontinued on November 7, 2017.}} and unwanted photos can be deleted from the photo album. The Camera cannot be used outside of the Drablands or in [[Download Play]].{{Cite|In the full version, photos can be freely taken within levels.|N/A|TFH}} Any [[Status Report]]s visible when the photo is taken will not appear in the saved screenshot, though other on-screen indicators including the [[Life Gauge]], the [[Energy Gauge]], and [[Communication Icon]]s, will be retained. If the 3D slider is turned on when the photo is taken, then the screenshot will be viewable in 3D. ==={{BotW|-}}=== In {{BotW}}, the Camera appears as a [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. It is an ancient piece of [[Sheikah]] technology.{{Cite|A Camera is a type of ancient Sheikah technology that allows you to capture the image of a person or object.|Camera Manual|BotW}} It is obtained in the [[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]] from [[Purah]] after bringing [[Blue Flame]] to the [[Ancient Furnace]] outside of the Lab. Link must place the Sheikah Slate into the [[Guidance Stone]] in the Lab to repair the Slate and restore missing files. Doing so will add the Camera Rune, the Album, and the [[Hyrule Compendium]] to the Sheikah Slate.{{Cite|Camera, Hyrule Compendium, and album missing files confirmed. Starting repair.|Guidance Stone|BotW}} With the Hyrule Compendium, Link also receives the [[Sheikah Sensor +]]. After obtaining the Camera Rune, Purah asks Link to try it out by taking a Picture of her.{{Cite|Take a {{Color BotW|Red|picture}} of me with the {{Color BotW|Red|Camera}}! Oh, and don't forget to lemme see it!|Purah|BotW}} The Camera Rune allows [[Link]] to take a Picture by pressing the 'A' button, which is saved to the Album.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Pictures}} you take with the {{Color BotW|Blue|Camera}} are stored in the {{Color BotW|Blue|album}}.|Symin|BotW}} Link can aim the Camera with either the right analog stick or the gyroscope. Link can zoom in and out by pressing up and down on the D-pad. Link can also quickly access the Album by pressing the minus button and take a Self-Portrait by pressing the 'X' button. While taking a Self-Portrait, Link can position himself in eleven poses by using combinations of the left analog stick (up, down, left and right), the ZL button (ZL + up and ZL + down) and different types of weapons (one handed, one handed + shield, two handed, spear and bow). If Link takes a Picture of certain creatures, monsters, [[Material]]s, [[Treasure Chest]]s, Ore Deposits, or pieces of equipment, it will be logged in the Hyrule Compendium.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Pictures}} of animals and objects will be automatically registered in the {{Color BotW|Blue|Hyrule Compendium}}.|Purah|BotW}} After being logged, Link can view information about the subject in the Compendium or track it with the Sheikah Sensor +. The Camera's Album comes with twelve Old Landscape Photos that were taken by [[Princess Zelda]] 100 years ago.{{Cite|Yes, there are also some {{Color BotW|Red|old landscape photos}} stored in the {{Color BotW|Blue|album}}. I knew Princess Zelda had made frequent use of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Camera}} feature, but this...|Purah|BotW}} After obtaining the Camera Rune and speaking to [[Impa]], she will instruct Link to go to each location in all of Zelda's Pictures to recover his [[Recovered Memory|Memories]].{{Cite|Princess Zelda's memories are your memories as well. Visit the locations chronicled by the {{Color BotW|Red|Camera}}, and you may be able to recover bits of your memory.|Impa|BotW}} By visiting these locations, Link will experience a flashback of a Memory with Zelda where the Picture was taken. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Quests|width= 37.1rem| {{TotK Quest |name= Camera Work in the Depths |type= Main Quest |giver= [[Josha]] |location= [[Lookout Landing]] }} }} {{Stub|TotK}} The Camera is unlocked during the "[[Camera Work in the Depths]]" [[Main Quest]]. As part of the Quest, [[Robbie]] discovers that the [[Purah Pad]]'s Camera and the [[Hyrule Compendium]] have both been locked, though he is able to fix this. Once this has been done, [[Link]] can take a [[Picture]] of a [[Statue That Points the Way]] for [[Josha]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Camera Rune is featured as a crucial part of Zelda's Special Attack when she is using her starting weapon class, which is Sheikah Runes. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:TFH Photo
